verdict.rationale: The axis applies because any product with public docs could publish llms.txt or agent-oriented docs, but Aider shows no evidence of doing so. Probes returned HTTP 404 for https://aider.chat/llms.txt and for the markdown version of the docs pages. The /web command only lets Aider read other sites' pages; it does not give Aider's own docs an agent-friendly form.
